mapper.select: select t.create_by as userId, COALESCE(u.nick_name, CASE WHEN t.create_by LIKE 'fake_like_%' THEN CONCAT('虚拟用户', SUBSTRING(t.create_by, 11)) WHEN t.create_by IS NULL OR t.create_by = '' THEN '游客' ELSE t.create_by END) as nickName from (select distinct create_by from px_wallpaper_download_record) t left join sys_user u on t.create_by = u.user_id order by nickName

SELECT f.name AS folder_name, COUNT(*) AS count FROM px_wallpaper_download_record d INNER JOIN px_wallpaper w ON d.item_id = w.id INNER JOIN px_wallpaper_folder f ON w.folder = f.id GROUP BY f.name ORDER BY count DESC
select count(*) from px_wallpaper_download_record where create_by = #{userId} and date(create_time) = curdate()
